footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Antero Resources: after $40.6M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 22.0% to $5.3B in 2025. Gross margin was 42.2%, versus 31.8% a year earlier, and operating income rose 1921.0× to $884M, a 16.7% margin.
Net income rose 11.1× to $634M, or $2.03 per share. Operating cash flow was $1.6B and free cash flow $1.6B, versus $838M; Antero Resources returned $136M through buybacks.
watch: Cost of revenue is 58% of revenue.
